captions.story: Journey ten thousand meters down into the Kermadec Trench to see what defies the pressure.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Kermadec Trench?
story.summary: This episode explores the Kermadec Trench, revealing how giant supergiant amphipods survive under immense pressure in total darkness. It highlights how life adapts to the most extreme environments on Earth.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Kermadec Trench?
